not_client_data: Synthetic data. It describes no real company, no real ownership structure and no real bank's book, and must not be presented as client data.

universe.not_client_data: Synthetic data. It describes no real company, no real ownership structure and no real bank's book, and must not be presented as client data.

domains.name: CORPORATE CUSTOMER MASTER
domains.purpose: Who the borrower is: legal identity, aliases, group membership, segment, sector, geography and relationship ownership, as at each quarter.
domains.notes: Names, aliases and the Arabic name are the inputs entity resolution works on, so they live here rather than being derived anywhere else.

domains.name: CORPORATE RATINGS
domains.purpose: The internal grade on the master scale, the model that produced it, any override, and the movement against the previous assessment.

domains.name: CORPORATE FACILITIES / EXPOSURE
domains.purpose: Every facility granted to a corporate borrower: limit, drawn and undrawn, funded and unfunded, product, currency and security status, at each quarter end.
domains.notes: One row per facility per quarter, not one per borrower.

domains.name: CORPORATE IFRS 9
domains.purpose: The staging decision and the expected credit loss behind it: PD, LGD, EAD, twelve-month and lifetime ECL, scenario weighting and any management overlay.
domains.notes: The Borrower 360 snapshot copies stage and final_ecl. It is never authoritative over them - B2.

domains.name: CORPORATE DPD / DELINQUENCY
domains.purpose: Days past due, the arrears bucket, the amount overdue, missed payments and whether collections have been engaged.

domains.name: CORPORATE FINANCIALS
domains.purpose: Spread financial statements and the credit ratios derived from them, with the statement date and its age so a stale ratio can be recognised as stale.

domains.name: CORPORATE COVENANTS
domains.purpose: Every covenant tested, the threshold, the observed value, the headroom and whether it breached.
domains.notes: One row per covenant test per quarter.

domains.name: CORPORATE COLLATERAL
domains.purpose: Security held: type, market and eligible value, the valuation date and how old it is, and the coverage it provides against the secured exposure.
domains.notes: One row per collateral item per quarter.

domains.name: CORPORATE GUARANTEES
domains.purpose: Guarantees given and received between counterparties: the guarantor, the beneficiary, the covered amount and the legal form.
domains.notes: Both a credit fact and a graph edge. Recorded once, here, and read by the guarantee graph rather than copied into it.

domains.name: CORPORATE LIMITS / LARGE EXPOSURES
domains.purpose: Single-name and group utilisation against the eligible capital reference, and the large-exposure status that follows from it.
domains.notes: The capital reference and thresholds here are synthetic data parameters, not verified regulatory limits - B55.

domains.name: CORPORATE WATCHLIST / QUALITATIVE SIGNALS
domains.purpose: Qualitative concerns recorded against a borrower: the signal, its severity, who raised it and when, and the watchlist grade that resulted.

domains.name: CORPORATE RESTRUCTURING / FORBEARANCE
domains.purpose: Concessions granted for credit reasons: the type, the date, the probation period and whether the exposure is still classified as forborne.

domains.name: CORPORATE PROFITABILITY / RAROC
domains.purpose: Revenue, cost of risk, capital consumed and the risk-adjusted return on it, per borrower per quarter.

domains.name: CORPORATE OWNERSHIP & CONTROL GRAPH
domains.purpose: Observed shareholding and voting relationships between legal entities and persons, each with the source it was asserted by and the period it is valid for.
domains.notes: Observed edges only. Effective ownership, control closure and connected groups are DERIVED and live in their own datasets so the derivation stays inspectable - B14.

domains.name: CORPORATE SUPPLY CHAIN GRAPH
domains.purpose: Declared supplier and customer relationships, the share of each party's revenue or cost they represent, and how that was evidenced.
domains.notes: Commercial dependence is not control and is never used to form a regulatory group - B21.

domains.name: CORPORATE EXPOSURE NETWORK
domains.purpose: Financial claims between counterparties in the book: intercompany lending, receivables concentration and the guarantee-backed exposure that links two names.

domains.name: CORPORATE CONNECTED COUNTERPARTY GRAPH
domains.purpose: The derived connected-counterparty groups: which borrowers were grouped, on which basis, and the evidence chain that put each one there.
domains.notes: Derived, not observed. Graph connectivity is not regulatory connectedness - B54.

domains.name: CORPORATE ENTITY RESOLUTION
domains.purpose: Which source records were judged to be the same legal entity, by which rule, with what confidence, and whether a human has reviewed it.
domains.notes: Source records are never destructively merged - B7. The mapping is additive and reversible.

domains.name: CORPORATE GRAPH DATA QUALITY
domains.purpose: What is wrong with the graph and how much of the answer depends on it: missing ownership, percentages that do not sum, cycles, stale assertions and unresolved duplicates.

lineage.why_no_authoritative_fields: B2. The Borrower 360 snapshot is a denormalised READ. Every field in it is a copy of, or a derivation from, a field some other domain owns. A field marked AUTHORITATIVE here would be a field the snapshot had taken ownership of, and the domain that owns it would no longer be the last word on its own number.

snapshot.authority_note: B2. Every field here is a copy of, or a derivation from, a field another domain owns. The snapshot is authoritative over nothing.
